title: Megurine Luka — Their Music Video〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, that should do it for these windows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, those wall stickers on the windows are really cute.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow, they are cute. Did you make these, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I did my best to make them look like shooting stars. They're perfect for celebrating Leo/need's success, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The snacks and drinks are also ready.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you.
We should have more than enough for their post-festival party.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Luka, check this out!
Len and I wrote a message on the chalkboard congratulating them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“Congratulations on Jam Fest!”
Hehe. It's so fun and colorful.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But it's missing something with just the words...
Shouldn't we make it a little more festive?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we gussy it up by adding a few drawings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I know.
What if we drew pictures relating to their songs, the festival and such?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, great idea!
Like instruments, musical notes and stuff☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what if I made it look all fizzy like a bottle of FizzYum Cider?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds really hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's always good to challenge yourself.
Do your best, Rin. We'll be looking forward to seeing what you draw.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, this classroom looks so lively now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is the least we could do, since we're here to celebrate the girls' success.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they put on such a wonderful performance. We need to congratulate them thoroughly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, they really did put on an amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They did! And they were so cool even at such a big event!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was honestly a little worried how they'd do before they took the stage.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Are you nervous, Ichi?
Your lips are pursed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry. This is our first big festival, and we have to follow some really amazing performances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If someone asked me right now whether or not we'll be able to do what they just did...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our plan was to just watch quietly, but we definitely wondered if we should go talk to them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We didn't have to in the end, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It was so cool how Honami kept them all together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm sure she was also nervous...
But even so, she made sure the others could rely on her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which would certainly explain why they ended up playing so well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They all coalesced around Honami.
And they were able to put on an incredible performance at their first big festival as a result.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and it was a good expression of who they are as a band.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier for them, getting such a good response from the audience.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So let's make this party great for them, for all the effort they've put in.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're celebrating them doing well at that festival, right? So, why don't we celebrate by having our own?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our own festival?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't think of anything off the top of my head...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, how about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We could make the show we've been planning on doing for them feel more like a music festival.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can make it seem like a variety of artists are performing by forming our own groups or performing solo and such.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that seems like the perfect way to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we'll also need to come up with group names.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. As well as a schedule.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, let's start by picking groups, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
